build_command: LEAN_NUM_THREADS=2 lake build Aeneas AeneasMeta WhirAeneas.Std.Bulk WhirAeneas.Std.Guards WhirAeneas.Toolchain.StringLiteral
build_observation: Both backend libraries and stdlib content/guard lemmas check in one Lean 4.34.0 environment. Genuine BvTac, Step, tuple, and coinduction examples are preserved; obsolete wording-only diagnostics are removed.
compatibility_option_scope: backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false is confined to coinductive modules and their coinductive test. Slice reconstruction uses the checked slice extensionality theorem instead of that compatibility option.
string_literal_before: WhirAeneas.Toolchain.assertMessage depends on WhirAeneas.Toolchain.assertMessage._native.decide.ax_1 with the unpatched String.toStr default proof.
string_literal_after: WhirAeneas.Toolchain.assertMessage depends only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound with the kernel-checked default proof.
exported_helper_audit: WhirAeneas.Audit checks generated function constants and exhaustively audits all theorem constants in WhirAeneas and Aeneas.Std.WrappingShiftRhs. The current 28-theorem census and the generated function audits contain only subsets of propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; the audit fails on any project axiom declaration or other transitive axiom.
model_execution: Importing actual Whir.FieldTower from the pinned #551 package and running compiled E operations returns (27,14,12) for (2,3,4)*(5,6,7), with additive zero, multiplicative identity, and subtraction checked through the canonical executable superclass dictionaries.
boundary: This portability and helper audit is not full verifier extraction or an acceptance/rejection correspondence theorem. Capacity, allocation and OOM behavior are not supplied by Vec content lemmas. Final anchored verifier/model source pins remain a separate prerequisite.
